<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><b>EXPLANATORY NOTE</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p id="xdx_98F_edei--AmendmentDescription_c20260806__20260806_z22MCgygucz8" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-08-06" id="Fact000027" name="dei:AmendmentDescription">This
Current Report on Form 8-K/A (this &#8220;<b>Report</b>&#8221;) amends the Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities
and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<b>SEC</b>&#8221;) on August 6, 2026 (the &#8220;<b>Original 8-K</b>&#8221;) by BioKey (Cayman),
Inc. (the &#8220;<b>Company</b>&#8221;) disclosing that on August 1, 2026, the audit committee of the board of directors (the &#8220;<b>Board</b>&#8221;)
of the Company dismissed Simon &amp; Edward LLP (&#8220;<b>S&amp;E</b>&#8221;) as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting
firm and approved the engagement of Kreit &amp; Chiu CPA LLP (&#8220;<b>KC</b>&#8221;) as its new independent registered public accounting
firm.</ix:nonNumeric></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This Report is being filed to disclose that the
Company has received a copy of S&amp;E&#8217;s letter, and the Company is filing a copy of this letter pursuant to Regulation S-K Item
304(a)(3).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 4.01 Changes in Registrant&#8217;s Certifying Accountant.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On August 6, 2026, the Company received a copy of a letter from S&amp;E,
stating whether it agrees or disagrees with the statements in the Company&#8217;s Original 8-K. A copy of this letter is filed herewith
as Exhibit 16.1 to this Report.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>
